aiPrompt.intro: I keep a daily journal with trackers. Below is my data. Mood is my own rating from 1 (awful) to 10 (amazing). A day with no value means I did not log it, not a zero.
aiPrompt.question1: Start with the three findings that matter most, each with the numbers behind it.
aiPrompt.question2: Keep what the data shows apart from what you guess. Two trackers that move together do not prove that one causes the other.
aiPrompt.question3: Say when a pattern rests on too few days to trust.
aiPrompt.question4: Suggest two or three small changes I can try for two weeks, and what to track to see if they work.
aiPrompt.question5: Point out anything worth bringing to a doctor. Do not diagnose.
aiPrompt.question6: If the data leaves you unsure, ask me up to three questions first.
aiPrompt.effects: Mood on days with and without
aiPrompt.customQuestion: Also check whether {{name}} relates to my mood, the same day or the day after.
